_note: avenCITY biomes — v0.4. TEN biomes, each extracting exactly ONE resource. Every hex is composed of 1 or 2 biomes; extraction requires a FACTORY dome on a hex with the matching biome. yieldPerBatch = units per extraction batch at dome LV.1. All land belongs to the CITY SPARK — hexes are rented, never sold.

unlock._note: A new hexagon opens only when at least 10 citizens pool 300,000 HEARTS. Every spawning player's grant earmarks exactly one founder share.

groundRent._note: Every dome pays ground rent scaled by its level: LV.1 = 6/day, LV.5 = 30/day. Land is used, never owned.
